sections.Profile:
The "Tennessee" pinball machine, released by Williams Manufacturing Company on February 28, 1948, is a single-player, electro-mechanical game designed by Harry Williams, with artwork by George Molentin.

- Manufacturer: Williams Electronic Games Inc.
- Years made: 1948
- In production: no
- Type: Electro-Mechanical
- Display: Lights
- Players: 1
- Tags: America, Single Player, US States, Women, Wood Rail, Original Theme
